#1
एवं|evam|evam — thus, in this way (adverb)
सततयुक्ता|satata-yuktāḥ|satata — constant, always (first compound member);;yukta — disciplined, yoked, devoted (past participle of yuj; nom. pl. masc., agreeing with bhaktāḥ; -āḥ dropped before the following y-)
ये|ye|yad — who (ye: nom. pl. masc. relative)
भक्तास्त्वां|bhaktāḥ tvām|bhakta — devotee (nom. pl. masc.);;tvam — you (tvām: acc. sg.; -āḥ + t- → -ās t-)
पर्युपासते|paryupāsate|pari-upa-ās — to worship, attend upon, serve devotedly (paryupāsate: present middle 3rd pl. 'they worship'; pari + upāsate → paryupāsate, -i + u- → -y u-)
--
ये|ye|yad — who (ye: nom. pl. masc. relative)
चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं|ca api akṣaram avyaktam|ca — and;;api — even, also (ca + api → cāpi, a + a → ā);;akṣara — the imperishable (acc. sg. neut., object of paryupāsate, carried over from line 1; api + akṣaram → apyakṣaram, -i + a- → -y a-);;avyakta — unmanifest (acc. sg. neut.; akṣaram + avyaktam simply written together, final -m unchanged before the vowel)
तेषां|teṣām|tad — that, they (teṣām: gen. pl. 'of them')
के|ke|kim — who? which? (ke: nom. pl. masc.)
योगवित्तमाः|yoga-vit-tamāḥ|yoga — yoga, discipline (first compound member);;vid — to know (vit-, 'knower', second compound member);;tama — superlative suffix '-most, best' (yoga-vit-tama: 'the best knower of yoga', nom. pl. masc.)
#2

उपासते|upāsate|upa-ās — to worship, wait upon (upāsate: present middle 3rd pl. 'they worship')
--
श्रद्धया|śraddhayā|śraddhā — faith (instr. sg. 'with faith')
परयोपेतास्ते|parayā upetāḥ te|para — supreme, highest (parayā: instr. sg. fem., agreeing with śraddhayā: 'with supreme faith'; parayā + upetāḥ → parayopetāḥ, -ā + u- → -o-);;upa-i — to come to possess, approach (upeta: past participle 'endowed with, possessed of', nom. pl. masc.);;tad — they (te: nom. pl. masc.; upetāḥ + te → upetās te, -āḥ + t- → -ās t-)
मे|me|aham — I (me: enclitic gen. sg. 'by me' (genitive of agent with mataḥ))

#3

शुचिर्दक्ष|śuciḥ dakṣaḥ|śuci — pure (nom. sg.; śuciḥ + dakṣaḥ → śucir dakṣaḥ, -iḥ + d- → -ir d-);;dakṣa — skillful, capable (nom. sg.; -aḥ dropped before the vowel u- of udāsīnaḥ)
उदासीनो|udāsīnaḥ|udāsīna — indifferent, unconcerned, neutral (nom. sg.; -aḥ before g- → -o)
गतव्यथः|gata-vyathaḥ|gata — gone, departed (past participle of gam, first member);;vyathā — anguish, distress (gata-vyatha: 'free of distress', nom. sg.)

धर्म्यामृतमिदं|dharmya-amṛtam idam|dharmya — righteous, in accord with dharma (first member; dharmya + amṛta → dharmyāmṛta, -a + a- → -ā-);;amṛta — nectar, ambrosia, the deathless (dharmya-amṛta: 'this nectar of dharma', acc. sg. neut.);;idam — this (idam: acc. sg. neut., in apposition)
यथोक्तं|yathā-uktam|yathā — as, according to (first compound member; yathā + uktam → yathoktam, -ā + u- → -o-);;vac — to speak (ukta: past participle 'spoken, said'; yathā-ukta: 'as has been said', acc. sg. neut., agreeing with idam)
पर्युपासते|paryupāsate|pari-upa-ās — to worship, attend upon (present middle 3rd pl.)

श्रद्दधाना|śraddadhānāḥ|śrad-dhā — to have faith, believe (śraddadhāna: present middle participle 'having faith', nom. pl. masc.; -āḥ before m- → -ā)
मत्परमा|mat-paramāḥ|mad — me (stem form, first member);;parama — supreme, highest (mat-parama: 'having me as their highest goal', nom. pl. masc.; -āḥ before bh- → -ā)
भक्तास्तेऽतीव|bhaktāḥ te atīva|bhakta — devotee (nom. pl. masc.; bhaktāḥ + te → bhaktās te, -āḥ + t- → -ās t-);;tad — they (te: nom. pl. masc.; te + atīva → te'tīva, -e + a- → -e ' with avagraha);;atīva — exceedingly, very much (adverb)
मे|me|aham — I (enclitic gen. sg. 'to me')
प्रियाः|priyāḥ|priya — dear (nom. pl. masc., predicate)
